description:
Job Title: Applied AI & Mission Systems Engineer 
 
Job Category: Engineering 
 
Time Type: Full time 
 
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: TS/SCI with Polygraph 
 
Employee Type: Regular 
 
Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10% 
 
Type of Travel: Local 
 
 
* * * 
 
 Overview 
 Embed engineers directly with operators and analysts to accelerate mission execution. 
 We build AI agents, automation, data-processing tools, and mission software enabling faster, safer workflows. 
 This requisition covers workflow automation, data engineering, cyber operations tooling, and agentic AI.  
 Have any of these skills? We encourage you to apply—candidates meeting any portion of the requirements are welcomed. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 
 Engage with operators and analysts to understand mission workflows and requirements. 
 Develop AI-enabled tools, agentic workflows, MCP servers, and system integrations in Python. 
 Use AI coding assistants daily and validate generated code. 
 Participate in design reviews, debugging, workflow testing, and documentation. 
 Communicate progress, risks, and tradeoffs effectively to leadership. 
 
 Senior Applied AI Engineer (Additions) 

 Lead mission engagements from scoping through production. 
 Architect LLM-driven agentic systems integrating mission data sources. 
 Define guardrails, approval flows, and audit logging for autonomous agents. 
 Develop evaluation suites to measure accuracy, reliability, and failure modes. 
 Mentor engineers and establish standards for AI-assisted development. 
 
 Applied AI Engineer (Mid-Level Additions) 

 Develop and test agentic components and mission data tools. 
 Support requirements discussions and learn mission tradecraft. 
 Write evaluation cases verifying correctness of AI behaviors. 
 Collaborate with senior engineers to troubleshoot workflows. 
 
 Mission Systems / Site Reliability Engineer (Additions) 

 Support and maintain high-availability mission systems. 
 Diagnose distributed system and dataflow failures. 
 Build observability, automated recovery, and CI/CD workflows. 
 Manage AWS, RHEL9 systems, and core mission infrastructure. 
 Administer Elasticsearch, MongoDB, Redis, and graph databases. 
 
 Required Skills 

 Strong Python experience with production APIs or data pipelines. 
 Understanding of LLM workflows including tool calling and structured outputs. 
 Proficiency with Git, testing, debugging, and CI/CD. 
 Experience using AI coding assistants (Copilot, Claude Code, etc.). 
 Clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

 
 
 
 
- 
 
 What You Can Expect: 
  A culture of integrity. 
 At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.
 An environment of trust. 
 CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.
 A focus on continuous growth. 
 Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.
 
 

 Pay Range : 
 There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.
 
 The proposed salary range for this position is: 
$113,200 - $237,800 
 
 
 
 CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
